question: In which year did Mahatma Gandhi start the Rowlatt Satyagraha?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1919. **__**
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• On **6 April 1919**, **Mahatma Gandhi started a non-violent Satyagraha against the British.**
 
• The **Champaran Satyagraha of 1917 was the first Satyagraha movement led by Gandhi in India** and is also known as an important revolution in the Indian Independence Movement.
 
• It was a **farmer's revolution** that took place in the Champaran quarter of Bihar, India, during the British colonisation, Rowaltt Act was passed by the British government. 
 
• This Act which gave the Police more power was against the people. The Act was called as **“ No Dalil, No Vakil, No Appeal.**
